Paragraph:
Translation: The blowing of these different conchshells became uproarious, and thus, vibrating both in the sky and on the earth, it shattered the hearts of the sons of Dhrtarastra.

Purport: When Bhisma and the others on the side of Duryodhana blew their respective conchshells, there was no heart-breaking on the part of the Pandavas. Such occurrences are not mentioned, but in this particular verse it is mentioned that the hearts of the sons of Dhrtarastra were shattered by the sounds vibrated by the Pandavas' party. This is due to the Pandavas and their confidence in Lord Krsna. One who takes shelter of the Supreme Lord has nothing to fear, even in the midst of the greatest calamity.
Situation/Problem_Faced: The unified, grounded sound of the Pandavas' conchshells echoes powerfully across the battlefield, directly impacting the psychological state of the opposing Kaurava army.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: The sound 'shatters the hearts' of the Kauravas. The purport emphasizes the contrast: the Kauravas' earlier noise did not break the Pandavas' resolve, because the Pandavas were anchored in divine confidence, whereas the Kauravas were anchored only in fragile material ego.
Outcome/Resolution: The Kauravas experience a profound, collective panic and demoralization before a single weapon is even fired.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Bhaya (Intense fear and existential dread stemming from a disconnection with the Divine)
Asraddha (Lack of faith, leaving the mind vulnerable to external shocks)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: The verse illustrates the fragility of a mind divorced from truth. Those who rely solely on material strength (the Kauravas) have easily shattered hearts because their foundation is an illusion. Those who take shelter in the Supreme Truth (the Pandavas) remain unshakeable, regardless of external intimidation.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: This depicts an acute stress response and sudden psychological collapse. The Kauravas' fragile ego, built on overcompensation and numbers, crumbles instantly upon encountering genuine, grounded strength. It proves that intimidation tactics fail against individuals who possess deep internal security and psychological safety.
